name: Boiler fuel gas train (double block and bleed)
description: Pre-assembled piping that conditions and safely isolates gaseous fuel before the burner: regulator, main shutoff valves, vent, pressure switches and manual isolation. Cleaver-Brooks lists natural gas, refinery gas, hydrogen, landfill, digester and tail gas; trains are designed to NFPA 85, FM, CSA B149.3 and ASME B31.1/B31.3 with SIL and hazardous-area options.

specifications.basis: Natural gas, refinery gas, hydrogen, landfill gas, digester gas and tail gas
NFPA 85, FM, CSA B149.3, ASME B31.1 or B31.3; SIL and hazardous-location designs offered
specifications.value: NFPA 85 / FM / CSA B149.3 / ASME B31.1 or B31.3

specifications.basis: Zeeco PLN/GO standard equipment: ventless regulator, ventless dual block main gas shutoff valves, high/low pressure switches and two manual gas valves
specifications.value: dual block main shutoff with ventless regulator
